 Sales development reps spend most of their day on non-selling activities like research, data entry, and CRM updates. The actual conversations that close deals might only take up an hour of their day, if they’re lucky. That math doesn’t work when trying to hit big pipeline numbers with a small team. 
 AI SDR platforms promise to flip that equation. They handle the grind so reps can focus on the 10% that actually moves revenue. But with a crowded market and big claims, it’s important to understand the hidden costs to protect ROI. Not every platform delivers what it advertises, and picking the wrong one means months of frustration before starting over.
